title: Europe's cyber weak spot is the everyday businesses nobody thought to protect
summary: The article discusses the increasing vulnerability of everyday businesses to cyber attacks, highlighting that known weaknesses are being exploited by cybercriminals. With advancements in AI, these criminals are becoming more efficient in their operations, posing a significant threat to businesses that previously went unprotected. The piece emphasizes the urgent need for these businesses to adopt better cybersecurity measures to safeguard against potential sabotage.
shadowing: Everyday businesses are increasingly exposed to cyber sabotage.
Known vulnerabilities are leaving these businesses unprotected.
AI enables cybercriminals to work better and faster.
There is an urgent need for improved cybersecurity measures.
Cyber attacks are becoming more sophisticated and frequent.
